s: Dine qedushsha ubo d' seipim: keshem shemmitzvat qaddish hi shehashsheliach tzibbur omer "yitgaddal veyitqaddash ku'" bishbil kol hatztzibbur vehem onim acharayv "amen yehe" umekavvenim — kak hi mitzvat haqqedushsha lekattechilla sheyyomar hashsheliach tzibbur "naqdishak" o "neqaddesh" vehatztzibbur shoteqin umekavvenim lemah sheshsheliach tzibbur omer ad shemmaggia liqdushsha veaz onin hatztzibbur "qadosh", veken bi"leummatam" [ub]"ubedibre qodsheka". Vaapillu im yesh t' veyoter hashshomeim umekavvenim lashsheliach tzibbur — (en layyachid lomar im hashsheliach tzibbur "naqdishak" o "neqaddesh", shekkevan sheqqabeu nussach zeh biqdushsha — yesh linhog bo din qedushsha kemo be"qadosh" u"baruk", veen omerim dabar shebbiqdushsha bepachot measara, velishliach tzibbur yesh t' hashshomeim umekavvenim lo, velo mi shomea?) Veim ratza lomar milla bemilla im hashsheliach tzibbur belachash — en issur baddabar, shekkevan shehem omerim kol milla umilla yachdav — amirat shenehem nechshebet keachat, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qp"g. Ella sheen laasot ken lekattechilla ella middochaq, ukemo sheyyitbaer sham, ukemo shennitbaer besiman q"t. Vekol zeh beyachid, abal im kol hatztzibbur nahagu lomar "naqdishak" im hashsheliach tzibbur, ap al pi sheen omerim belachash milla bemilla im hashsheliach tzibbur — en limchot, kevan shemmaqdishin baasara. Veap al pi sheeno niqra tzibbur ella kesheechad omer vet' shomein veonin, abal keshekkol echad omer leatzmo kichidim hem kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqtz"d, mikkol maqom bedabar shebbiqdushsha — en tzarik lekak, shello ameru ella: en omerim dabar shebbiqdushsha bepachot measara, abal asara rashshaim kullam lomar "neqaddesh", kemo sheomerim "qadosh" u"baruk" shehu iqqar haqqedushsha, veap al pi ken omerim kol hatztzibbur apillu shello bederek aniyya achar hashsheliach tzibbur, kegon qedushshat "uba letziyyon" ledibre haomerim sheenah neemeret ella baasara. Ella shebbiqdushshat y"ch yesh linhog lekattechilla kemo beqaddish, she"amen yehe shemeh rabba" hu aniyya sheonin hatztzibbur achar "yitgaddal" sheamar hashsheliach tzibbur, kemo aniyyat amen achar habberakot, veken biqdushsha yesh laanot "qadosh" u"baruk" achar "naqdishak" o "neqaddesh" sheamar hashsheliach tzibbur, ella im ken middochaq shemmukrach lomar im hashsheliach tzibbur kemo shennitbaer besiman q"t. Veyesh nohagin ken mittaam hayyadua lahem apillu shello middochaq, lomar kol nussach haqqedushsha im hashsheliach tzibbur milla bemilla belachash vetebat "naqdishak venaaritzak" ve"qadosh qadosh qadosh" beqol ram:

Asur ledabber beemtza qedushsha. Vekol hamdabber — alayv hakkatub omer: "velo oti qarata yaaqob vego'", kemo shennitbaer besiman n"v. Vaapillu yesh minyan bilado — asur. Vaapillu lilmod, im lo beshaa shehashsheliach tzibbur menaggen bishat hanniggun, velo beshaa shemmechattek haotiyyot. Vehannussach shemmosipin beshabbat — eno mikkelal qedushsha. Umikkol maqom, asur lesapper ben "qadosh" le"baruk", kemo shennitbaer besiman n"v. Vetob shello lesapper ad achar amen shel "hael haqqadosh". Veyireh hashsheliach tzibbur lesayyem "leummatam ku' ubedibre ku'" qodem sheyyatchilu haqqahal "baruk" ve"yimlok":

Venohagin lissa haenayim lammarom beshaa sheomerim "qadosh qadosh qadosh". Vetob shettihyena segurot. Veken nohagin shemmenaanin gupan venosein oto min haaretz, vesemek lamminhag misseper hekalot: berukim attem laHashem shamayim veyorede merkaba im tomru vetaggidu lebanay mah sheani oseh beshaa shemmaqdishin veomerim "qadosh qadosh qadosh", velammedu otan sheyyihyu enehem nesuot lammarom lebet tepillatam venoseim atzmam lemala, ki en li hanaa baolam keotah shaa sheenehem nesuot beenay veenay beenehem, ubeotah shaa ani ochez bekisse kebodi bidmut yaaqob umechabbeqah umenashsheqah umazkir galutam umemaher geullatam. Veameru bammidrash: "ubishtayim yeopep", mikkan tiqqenu laup adam al raglayv beshaa sheomerim "qadosh qadosh qadosh", velo keotam sheddolegim veqopetzim. Veyesh mi sheqqabbala beyado sheyyarim gupo vaaqebayv lemala be"baruk" ve"yimlok" kemo be"qadosh". Veyesh mi shehaya noheg mittaam hayyadua lo likroa be"baruk" ve"yimlok" velizqop bashshem. Veen bazeh mishshum issur hishtachavaya bemaqom shello tiqqenu chakamim, kemo sheen issur bekorea beemtza birkot y"ch, mittaam shennitbaer besiman qy"g. Veyizzaher lekavven raglayv beshaa sheomer qedushsha im sheliach tzibbur, kemo shennitbaer besiman tz"h:
Hashshomea qedushsha bemaqom echad veniknas lebet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur omerim qedushsha — chozer veoneh immahem:
